lyrics: kuzhal oodum azhaga kaNNA kurai thIrayo
1 uLLum puram yEngum isai ponga veyng
2 vENNai uNNum vAyA oliyum mAya kaLvaNum neeyA kaNNiyar nEyA kadhir nigar thooyA un manam kaayA anbElAm poyyA agham urugavE
